name: timer
title: Timer
description: A dark pill shows a clock icon and a monospaced stopwatch counting in hundredths of a second. Start, Pause and Reset buttons below drive it, and the clock spins while it runs.
use: You need to show elapsed time next to start, pause and reset controls in a toolbar.
avoid: It only counts up, has no countdown or alarm, and zeroes whenever the loading prop flips.
a11y: It carries role timer with a polite live region, but the display grabs no focus and ignores reduced motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A compact dark pill with a thin light border holds a small clock glyph and a monospaced time such as 03.46. Under it the demo places three rounded buttons: Start, Pause and Reset.
behaves: Pressing Start sends the digits counting in hundredths of a second while the clock icon turns. Pause freezes the value and Reset returns it to zero, while the pill itself keeps its shape.
customise: Variant, size, time format and reset-on-change behaviour are props; the clock icon can be swapped and the label and readout have their own subcomponents.
weight: light: One animation frame loop only while running; the spin is pure CSS.
